post.description: Resolution/dispute risk score (0-100) for Polymarket markets: UMA status (proposed/disputed), UMA bond and reward, rules-text ambiguity (length, deadline date, declared resolution source), top-3 holder concentration as a vote-manipulation proxy, and days to resolution.
